data.description:
## Description

**What**: Define DefenseStore interface (load, write, load_for_region with no-op default). Implement TrackerDefenseStore that writes defenses as ticket comments and reads via ticket-show parsing. Enforce ticket-binding integrity: review without a session-bound ticket fails with exit 1 and stderr 'ticket-binding required'.
**Why**: SC3 tracker portion. Walking skeleton: this is the minimum store required for SC1 (statefulness) and SC4 (arbiter) to function locally.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - DefenseStore interface defined in plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.{py|sh}
  - TrackerDefenseStore.write() and load() round-trip via ticket comments
  - Multi-bound session disambiguation: most-recent-active story by last-transition-or-comment timestamp; lexicographic ticket-ID tiebreak
  - tests/review/test-defense-store-ticket-binding.sh validates the exit-1 + 'ticket-binding required' stderr behavior
  - load_for_region(region_files) returns load() filtered to records with cited_lines path intersecting region_files; no-op default returns all records unfiltered
  OUT:
  - GitHubPRDefenseStore (S12)
  - Mirror logic (S13)
  - Fingerprint computation (S7)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, /dso:review can write and read defenses via TrackerDefenseStore bound to the session ticket; review without a ticket fails with the documented error
  ← Satisfies: "DefenseStore with split backends, shared loader/writer, ticket-binding integrity, and explicit ordering contract"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Multi-bound session tiebreak (red team scenario #5) covered by unit tests for the recency function
- [Maintainability] Interface is the single point of contact for both backends

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a /dso:review orchestrator, I have a DefenseStore interface and TrackerDefenseStore backend with ticket-binding integrity
